Tuna & yogurt pita pockets

Original EZEATS recipe · editorially reviewed draft · owner review required · not kitchen-tested.

A yogurt-bound tuna filling brings cucumber crunch to a quick pita lunch.

Café-style · lunch, sandwich · easy

Servings: 2

Prep: 10 min

Cook: 0 min

Total: 10 min (estimate)

Estimated cost: USD 5 per serving. Not a price quote or a CAD conversion.

Diet and allergy suitability: unverified. Ingredient-list screening only, for the exact products specified. Brands, substitutions and cross-contact can change suitability. Editorial review is not kitchen testing or a medical or allergy-safety guarantee.

Known allergens: Fish, Milk, Wheat. This list may be incomplete; check package labels and cross-contact.

Before you cook

  • Before starting, wash hands with soap and water for 20 seconds. Rinse fresh produce under running water and use clean utensils.
  • Check every packaged ingredient label for dietary requirements and allergens, including cross-contact notices. Choose products with no additional allergenic ingredients beyond the warnings listed here; otherwise these ingredient-based recommendations no longer apply. Listed tags apply only to the specified ingredients; they are not allergy-safe guarantees.
  • Refrigerate perishable ingredients until needed. Refrigerate leftovers in shallow containers within 2 hours (within 1 hour above 90°F/32°C); reheat leftovers to 74°C/165°F.

Ingredients

  • 2 medium vegan wheat pita (Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 6 ounces canned tuna (170 g drained Drained, packed in water. Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 1/4 cup plain pasteurized Greek yogurt (Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 1/2 medium cucumber (diced)
  • 1 tablespoon fresh dill (chopped)
  • 1 tablespoon lemon juice
  • 2 leaves lettuce

Cooking instructions

  1. Flake the canned tuna into a bowl. Stir in the plain pasteurized Greek yogurt, lemon juice and fresh dill.
  2. Fold in the cucumber, keeping the pieces small enough to fit inside the bread.
  3. Halve the vegan wheat pita and open each pocket gently. Line with torn lettuce and spoon in the tuna filling.
  4. Serve two filled halves per person, or keep covered and refrigerated until lunch.
